profiles.name: derekldavis
profiles.tagline: TEE GAME IN A BODY BAG
profiles.profile: This is the kind of golf that makes the tee box look like a crime scene. Derek’s one-appearance sample is a full-on structural collapse off the tee, and the rest of the bag didn’t exactly show up with a hard hat either. The wild part is the occasional little flicker of competence in the middle of the chaos, but it’s buried under enough damage to qualify as a hostage situation. Right now the profile is less “slump” and more “please stop letting the driver narrate the round.”

profiles.name: BigTime
profiles.tagline: PAR 3 BULLY, PUTTING MENACE TO HIMSELF
profiles.profile: BigTime showed up for a par-3 scrap and played like a guy who can find greens but can’t cash the check once he gets there. The ball-striking was at least serviceable in spots, but the short game and putting combined to torch whatever decent work the rest of the bag created. That’s the frustrating part: there’s enough green-finding in here to convince you this should be playable, then the scorecard gets mugged by chips, three-putts, and general nonsense. One round isn’t a story yet, but the first chapter is ugly in the around-the-green department.
